title: Pays you to like, rate or review, then moves to Telegram
why: Paid-task scams pay a small amount first to build trust, then ask you to 'deposit' larger sums that you never see again.
examples: Like YouTube videos and earn Rs 50 for each one. Join our Telegram group for daily tasks.
Rate hotels on Google Maps and get paid. Message us on WhatsApp to start earning work.
safe: I will join the WhatsApp group for the class project.
Please review the document and send comments by Friday.
